Method of Attack: Spam campaign with malicious Word document attachment pretending to be signed W-9 tax forms
Malicious macros in Word document launch PowerShell command to install and execute the Trojan
Emotet downloads other malware including TrickBot which steals credentials and data
TrickBot opens connection to Ryuk ransomware operators who encrypt the network
Impacted Systems: Networks infected by TrickBot and Ryuk ransomware
Attack Vector: Spam email with malicious Word document attachment (W-9.doc)
Indicators of Compromise: Spam emails with subject pretending to be signed W-9 tax forms
Malicious Word document attachment named W-9.doc
EmoCheck tool to detect Emotet infection
